name: AMENDMENT_A2
reason: 2026-10-05 engineering amendment 2 of 2 (before the dependent fidelity check is rerun; no bank fit has run). Demonstrated defect after A1: with the snapshot's ONLINE critics the constant predictor wins every view on every epoch-2 minibatch for at least one encoder (seed 0: 42 batches with no proxy gradient, 19 with one; seed 1: all 61 with none), so the frozen-minibatch equivalence remained vacuous (receipts fid__s0/s1 kept in quarantine; raw fidelity itself passed bitwise again). Fix: the algebra check uses fresh deterministic bounded-refit critics fitted on the FROZEN epoch-2 model (CRITIC_FIT fit, CRITIC_VAL early stopping, the snapshot transform; rgj.train.fit_bounded), then the first epoch-2 minibatch with both proxy gradients nonzero; the online-critic applicability over the epoch is recorded as a diagnostic. No training code or trained arm changes.
